entries.title: Job 20:1
segments: ¶And Zophar the Naamathite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 20:2
segments: Therefore do my thoughts give me an answer, and for this is my haste within me.

entries.title: Job 20:3
segments: I hear a reproof putting me to shame; and [my] spirit answereth me by mine understanding.

entries.title: Job 20:4
segments: Knowest thou [not] this, that of old, since man was placed upon earth,

entries.title: Job 20:5
segments: The exultation of the wicked is short, and the joy of the ungodly man but for a moment?

entries.title: Job 20:6
segments: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds,

entries.title: Job 20:7
segments: Like his own dung doth he perish for ever; they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?

entries.title: Job 20:8
segments: He flieth away as a dream, and is not found; and is chased away as a vision of the night.

entries.title: Job 20:9
segments: The eye which saw him shall [see him] not again; and his place beholdeth him no more.

entries.title: Job 20:10
segments: ¶His children shall seek the favour of the poor, and his hands restore his wealth.

entries.title: Job 20:11
segments: His bones were full of his youthful strength; but it shall lie down with him in the dust.

entries.title: Job 20:12
segments: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth [and] he hide it under his tongue,

entries.title: Job 20:13
segments: [Though] he spare it, and forsake it not, but keep it within his mouth,

entries.title: Job 20:14
segments: His food is turned in his bowels; it is the gall of asps within him.

entries.title: Job 20:15
segments: He hath swallowed down riches, but he shall vomit them up again: *God shall cast them out of his belly.

entries.title: Job 20:16
segments: He shall suck the poison of asps; the viper's tongue shall kill him.

entries.title: Job 20:17
segments: He shall not see streams, rivers, brooks of honey and butter.

entries.title: Job 20:18
segments: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and not swallow down; its restitution shall be according to the value, and he shall not rejoice [therein].

entries.title: Job 20:19
segments: For he hath oppressed, hath forsaken the poor; he hath violently taken away a house that he did not build.

entries.title: Job 20:20
segments: Because he knew no rest in his craving, he shall save nought of what he most desired.

entries.title: Job 20:21
segments: Nothing escaped his greediness; therefore his prosperity shall not endure.

entries.title: Job 20:22
segments: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits; every hand of the wretched shall come upon him.

entries.title: Job 20:23
segments: ¶It shall be that, to fill his belly, he will cast his fierce anger upon him, and will rain it upon him into his flesh.

entries.title: Job 20:24
segments: If he have fled from the iron weapon, the bow of brass shall strike him through.

entries.title: Job 20:25
segments: He draweth it forth; it cometh out of his body, and the glittering point out of his gall: terrors are upon him.

entries.title: Job 20:26
segments: All darkness is laid up for his treasures: a fire not blown shall devour him; it shall feed upon what is left in his tent.

entries.title: Job 20:27
segments: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity, and the earth shall rise up against him.

entries.title: Job 20:28
segments: The increase of his house shall depart, flowing away in the day of his anger.

entries.title: Job 20:29
segments: This is the portion of the wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed to him by *God.
